source_files.usage: Chinese keys copied verbatim from user-provided original patch; no new translation generated

scope: Known original CR.REV components. No arbitrary tag member substitution; native crafted ingredients and runtime UI acceptance are separate checks.

comparison_files.usage: read-only selected recipe comparison; entire source differs
read-only selected recipe comparison; entire source differs

gt.lang.hazard.meltdown.after: Melts down when stored Heat is too much!

gt.lang.no.powerconducting.fluids.after: All entering Power Conductor Fluids will be voided!

gt.lang.nogui.funnel.tap.tank.after: No GUI. Use Tiny Funnels and Taps to interact!

gt.lang.use.magnifyingglass.to.detail.after: Use Magnifying Glass to see Details

gt.lang.use.monkey.wrench.to.set.input.s.after: Use Monkey Wrench to set Input Side

gt.lang.use.monkey.wrench.to.set.output..after: Use Monkey Wrench to set Output Side

gt.lang.use.monkey.wrench.to.toggle.auto.after: Use Monkey Wrench to toggle automatic Outputs

gt.lang.use.soft.hammer.to.toggle.after: Use Soft Hammer to toggle States

language_import.license: Original LH/CS: LGPL-3.0-or-later; Chinese strings copied verbatim from the user-provided patch.

adoption: Adopt original CR.DEF_REV_NCC/CR.REV and explicit OM.data known-material sums, including byproducts and output division; port IDs are mappings only.
limitations: Finite constant-expression parser, not a Java interpreter. Unknown automatic item data is omitted as original CR lookup permits; no arbitrary ore-tag member is chosen.
The inactive Netherite/source molecular scanner registrations are excluded. Extra port-only variants have no invented source recipe materials.

axle_wood_4 has no known automatic beamWood/creosote data. energy_storage_xv contains known Graphene but original 10099 references absent aRegistry.getItem(10049); the audit explicitly preserves that missing reference.
Registered recovery recipes and in-world recycling/melting acceptance were not run for this batch.
New installed-client probes are compiled only. Actual player hover, saved-world restart, historical save migration and complete survival chain remain unverified.

checks.outcome: failed: sandbox native Gradle DLL/cache access
failed: six WoodTreated alias compile errors, then fixed
passed: 28s, 50 core assertions and both native compileJava tasks
passed: 25s, 60 core assertions and both native/main/production smoke compilations

verification.ordinary_JAR_build: not run for this batch; grouped after further changes per user
